dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: We've never met.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: No... I don't believe we have.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: A face... a memory... a name...

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: ...Sigurd.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Sigurd? Who's that?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: I... cannot remember.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Is that supposed to mean something?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Perhaps. Or perhaps these old memories are playing tricks on me.
The goddess turns away, visibly troubled.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Forgive me. There is much I have forgotten.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Enough riddles. Did you know Papa?

dialogue.speaker: Coco
dialogue.text: Then tell me who killed him.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: ...Sigurd.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Sigurd? Who's that?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: I... cannot remember.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Is that supposed to mean something?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Perhaps. Or perhaps these old memories are playing tricks on me.
The goddess turns away, visibly troubled.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Forgive me. There is much I have forgotten.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Enough riddles. Did you know Papa?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Alden...
The goddess becomes quiet.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Yes. I remember him.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Then tell me who killed him.

feedback: Picked up the Griffin Wig. Return to the goddess.
“At last! Divine volume. The Bald Goddess thanks you—and requests a new title.”

dialogue.speaker: Sieg
dialogue.text: People in Emberbrook said Alden possessed something called the Ember.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Forgive me. There is much I have forgotten.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Enough riddles. Did you know Papa?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Alden...
The goddess becomes quiet.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Yes. I remember him.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Then tell me who killed him.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: I do not know, child.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: But you knew him!

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Knowing someone does not grant me knowledge of their fate.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: He was a good man. And he carried a burden that was never meant for one mortal alone.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: He was a good man. And he carried a burden that was never meant for one mortal alone.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: People in Emberbrook said Alden possessed something called the Ember.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: The Ember...

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: What is it?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: One of seven divine relics scattered across the mortal world long ago.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Seven?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Each relic carries power beyond ordinary magic. Together, they may accomplish things that mortals should hesitate even to imagine.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: They say the Ember can summon a god and grant a wish.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: The Ember does not grant wishes.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: It opens a door.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: A door to what?

feedback: Picked up the Griffin Wig. Return to the goddess.
“At last! Divine volume. The Bald Goddess thanks you—and requests a new title.”

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: The Ember...

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: What is it?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: One of seven divine relics scattered across the mortal world long ago.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Seven?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Each relic carries power beyond ordinary magic. Together, they may accomplish things that mortals should hesitate even to imagine.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: They say the Ember can summon a god and grant a wish.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: The Ember does not grant wishes.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: It opens a door.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: A door to what?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: To beings beyond your world. Some may answer your prayers. Others may see humanity as little more than an inconvenience.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: So whoever has it could bring a god here?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Under the right circumstances, perhaps. But opening a door cannot promise that what enters through it will be kind.

dialogue.speaker: Coco
dialogue.text: What?

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: It opens a door.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: A door to what?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: To beings beyond your world. Some may answer your prayers. Others may see humanity as little more than an inconvenience.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: So whoever has it could bring a god here?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Under the right circumstances, perhaps. But opening a door cannot promise that what enters through it will be kind.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Did Alden have the Ember?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: I cannot tell you.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Cannot, or will not?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: My memories are fractured, child. My strength has faded, and much of what I once knew is lost.
The goddess pauses, studying Coco.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: But I remember something else.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: What?

feedback: Picked up the Griffin Wig. Return to the goddess.
“At last! Divine volume. The Bald Goddess thanks you—and requests a new title.”

dialogue.speaker: Coco
dialogue.text: What promise?

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Cannot, or will not?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: My memories are fractured, child. My strength has faded, and much of what I once knew is lost.
The goddess pauses, studying Coco.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: But I remember something else.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: What?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Many years ago, Alden came to this shrine carrying a baby.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Yes.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: He was not alone. Someone accompanied him, though their face escapes me.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: What did he want?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: He asked me for a promise.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: What promise?

dialogue.speaker: Coco
dialogue.text: Papa was hiding me?

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: But I remember something else.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: What?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Many years ago, Alden came to this shrine carrying a baby.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Yes.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: He was not alone. Someone accompanied him, though their face escapes me.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: What did he want?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: He asked me for a promise.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: What promise?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: He said, 'If anyone comes asking for the child, tell them she was never here.'
Silence.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Papa was hiding me?

feedback: Picked up the Griffin Wig. Return to the goddess.
“At last! Divine volume. The Bald Goddess thanks you—and requests a new title.”

items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: He asked me for a promise.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: What promise?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: He said, 'If anyone comes asking for the child, tell them she was never here.'
Silence.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Papa was hiding me?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Protecting you, perhaps.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: From who?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: I wish I remembered.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Then what was the oath he wanted me to remember?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: An oath...
She looks troubled.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: I cannot answer that yet.

items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: He said, 'If anyone comes asking for the child, tell them she was never here.'
Silence.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Papa was hiding me?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Protecting you, perhaps.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: From who?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: I wish I remembered.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: Then what was the oath he wanted me to remember?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: An oath...
She looks troubled.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: I cannot answer that yet.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You keep saying you don't remember!

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And every forgotten memory is another reminder of how far I have fallen.

dialogue.speaker: Sieg
dialogue.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You keep saying you don't remember!

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And every forgotten memory is another reminder of how far I have fallen.
Sieg steps forward.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Is there anything you can tell us?

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Only this: whoever sought Alden may not have been seeking the Ember alone.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Only this: whoever sought Alden may not have been seeking the Ember alone.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Only this: whoever sought Alden may not have been seeking the Ember alone.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.

feedback: You chose: "I won't stop until I learn the truth."

items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth
items.description: A scrap of cloth with a symbol neither of them knows. Papa kept it with Coco's things from when she was little.

items.name: Drawing of Seven Stars
items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.

items.name: Moonleaf Herbs
items.description: A fresh bundle from Brynn's Apothecary. Paid for, for once.

items.name: Crystal Vial
items.description: Clear and empty. Papa is working on something.

items.name: Candlewick
items.description: A coil of cotton wick from the general store.

items.name: Fresh Bread
items.description: Alden's usual loaf from the village bakery. Still warm.

items.name: Honey Pastry
items.description: A very important magical ingredient. For happiness.

items.name: Alden's Journal
items.description: "If the Ember has been found, the others will not remain hidden for long. I can only hope the old guardian remembers what she promised."

items.name: Strange Cloth

items.description: Seven stars drawn in a ring around a dark circle.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And the path of heroism is often stained with despair.
Each of you decides, in your own heart, why you will go on.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: I won't stop until I learn the truth.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: I promised Alden I'd look after her.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Well, I suppose we're doing this.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: You could sound more excited.

dialogueLog.speaker: Sieg
dialogueLog.text: Someone has to keep you from burning down the world.

dialogueLog.speaker: Coco
dialogueLog.text: No promises.
The goddess watches them.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: Then go, children.

dialogueLog.speaker: Goddess
dialogueLog.text: And remember: not every truth brings comfort.
Coco and Sieg leave the shrine. Their footsteps fade into the distance.
